item.title: How to get a Nigerian visa: A step-by-step guide
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
Are you planning to visit Nigeria for business, tourism, or to see family and friends? If so, you'll need to obtain a Nigerian visa before your trip. In this guide, we'll tell you everything you need to know about how to get the visa. We'll explain how to check if you need one, what the required documents are, and how to submit your application online or at an embassy or consulate. By the end, you'll have all the information you need for a successful visa application.

Nigerian visa eligibility

The first step is to determine if you need a visa to enter Nigeria. You can check your visa eligibility using the tool provided by the Nigeria Immigration Service at https://immigration.gov.ng/visa-eligibility/. Most foreign nationals will need a visa, but citizens of certain countries may be able to obtain a visa on arrival or are visa-exempt for short stays.

Can I apply for a Nigerian visa online?

Yes, you can apply for a Nigeria visa online through the Nigeria Immigration Service portal. This is the most convenient option for most applicants. Alternatively, you can apply through a Nigerian embassy or consulate in your home country.

How to apply for a Nigerian visa online

To apply online, follow these steps:

  1. Go to the Nigeria Immigration Service portal at https://portal.immigration.gov.ng.
  2. Create an account or log in if you already have one.
  3. Fill out the visa application form with your personal details, purpose of visit, intended travel dates, etc.
  4. Upload the required documents, including your passport photo (see tips below).
  5. Pay the visa fee online using a credit or debit card.
  6. Submit your application and wait for a decision. You'll receive updates via email.

How to apply for a Nigerian visa through an embassy or consulate

If you prefer to apply through an embassy or consulate, here's what to do:

  1. Find the nearest Nigerian embassy or consulate in your country. You can check the list at https://portal.immigration.gov.ng/missions.
  2. Contact them to schedule a visa appointment and obtain the application forms.
  3. Fill out the visa application form and gather the required documents.
  4. Attend your visa appointment, submit your application materials, and pay the visa fee.
  5. The embassy or consulate will forward your application to Nigeria for processing. Wait for their decision and updates.

Documents required for a Nigerian visa

When applying for a Nigeria visa, you'll need to provide:

  • A completed visa application form
  • Your international passport, valid for at least 6 months beyond your intended stay
  • Passport-size photographs that meet Nigeria's specifications
  • Proof of sufficient funds to cover your stay
  • A letter of invitation from your host in Nigeria, if applicable
  • Evidence of hotel reservations or accommodation plans
  • Return flight tickets or an itinerary
  • Yellow fever vaccination certificate
  • Other documents as requested, depending on the purpose of your visit

Nigerian visa fees

Nigeria visa fees vary depending on your nationality, type of visa, and number of entries. For most nationalities, a short-stay single-entry visa costs around $160, while a multiple-entry visa valid for 3-12 months costs around $350. Confirm the exact fees on the Nigeria Immigration Service website as they may change.

Nigerian visa processing time

After submitting your application online or at the embassy/consulate, processing typically takes 5-7 business days, but can be longer in some cases. For online applications, if approved, you'll receive your e-visa via email which you'll need to print and present upon arrival in Nigeria along with your passport and other documents.

Tips for your Nigerian visa application

To ensure a smooth Nigeria visa application process:

  • Start the process well in advance of your intended travel dates to allow sufficient time for processing.
  • Make sure your passport is valid for at least 6 months from your planned arrival date in Nigeria.
  • Provide a high-quality, compliant passport photo. Using the Smartphone iD app is the easiest and cheapest way to get a compliant photo.
  • Double check that you have all the required documents before submitting your application to avoid delays.

Get your visa photo with Smartphone iD

Submitting a compliant visa photo is a crucial step in your Nigeria visa application. That's where Smartphone iD comes in. Our user-friendly app makes it simple to capture the perfect visa photo right from your smartphone. The app provides real-time instructions to ensure your photo meets Nigeria's specific requirements. After you take the photo, our advanced AI system and team of experts verify it for compliance. Once approved, your digital visa photo is sent directly to your email. With Smartphone iD, you get a guaranteed compliant visa photo at an affordable price, without the hassle of visiting a photo studio.

item.title: How to get an International Driving Licence in Nigeria
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
Are you planning to drive abroad? If so, you'll need an International Driving Permit (IDP) in addition to a valid Nigerian driver's license. An IDP is a legal document that translates your driver's information into multiple languages, allowing you to drive in over 150 countries worldwide. In this article, we'll guide you through the process of obtaining an IDP in Nigeria.

Who is eligible for an International Driving Licence?

To be eligible for an IDP, you must:

  • Be at least 18 years old
  • Hold a valid Nigerian driver's license
  • Have a clean driving record

Where to get an International Driving Licence in Nigeria

In Nigeria, the Federal Road Safety Corps (FRSC) is the only authorized agency to issue IDPs. You can apply for an IDP at any FRSC office nationwide. Unfortunately, online applications are not currently available, so you'll need to visit an FRSC office in person to apply.

How to apply for an International Driving Licence

To apply for an IDP, follow these steps:

  1. Locate and visit your nearest Federal Road Safety Corps (FRSC) office. You can find the list of FRSC offices on their official website (https://frsc.gov.ng/) or by contacting their helpline (+234 700 CALL FRSC or +234 700 2255 3772).
  1. Once at the FRSC office, fill out the IDP application form. The form will ask for your personal details, such as your name, address, date of birth, and contact information. Make sure to fill out the form accurately and completely to avoid any delays in processing your application.
  2. After completing the application form, present the required documents (see below). The FRSC officer will verify the authenticity and validity of your documents. If any discrepancies are found, you may be asked to provide additional clarification or documentation.
  3. Pay the applicable fees for your IDP. As of 2024, the fee for an IDP in Nigeria is ₦14,500. You can pay the fee using cash, a bank draft, or a certified check. Make sure to obtain a receipt for your payment, as you may need it for future reference.
  4. Once your application is processed and approved, you can collect your IDP from the same FRSC office where you submitted your application. When collecting your IDP, make sure to bring a valid form of identification, such as your passport or driver's license.

Required documents for an International Driving Licence application

When applying for an IDP, you'll need to provide the following documents:

  • A completed IDP application form
  • Your valid Nigerian driver's license
  • A copy of your passport data page
  • Two recent passport-sized photographs
  • A digital passport photo
  • Proof of payment of the applicable fees

Processing time, validity & fees 

Once you've submitted your application and required documents, the processing time for an IDP is usually 1-2 working days. The validity of an IDP is one year from the date of issuance. The current fee for an IDP in Nigeria is ₦14,500.

Collecting your International Driving Licence

After your IDP has been processed, you can collect it from the same FRSC office where you submitted your application. Make sure to bring a valid form of identification, such as your passport or driver's license, when collecting your IDP.

Get your International Driving Licence quickly with Smartphone iD

The Smartphone iD app streamlines the process of taking passport photos for your IDP application. The app provides step-by-step instructions to help you capture a compliant photo. After taking the picture, our advanced AI algorithms and team of experts analyze the image to ensure it meets the required standards. If any issues are detected, you'll be prompted to retake the photo. Once the picture is approved, it is directly sent to your email address, ready for usage.

item.title: How to get passport photos for your baby in Nigeria
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
Are you a parent in Nigeria looking to obtain a passport for your baby? An important element of the passport application process is providing a valid passport photo of your child. In this article, we'll explore all the requirements and steps involved in obtaining a Nigerian baby passport photo, ensuring that your little one's photo meets all the necessary criteria. 

Requirements and size

For all children, regardless of age, the passport photo must:

  • Have a plain white background, ensuring that the focus remains on the child's face
  • Show the child looking directly at the camera, with a neutral facial expression and both eyes open
  • Capture the child's full face, centered within the frame, with the head straight and not tilted
  • Feature the child alone, without any other objects or people visible, including the parent's hands or arms
  • Be taken within the last 6 months to ensure an accurate representation of the child's current appearance
  • Measure 1.5 inches by 1.5 inches (3.5cm x 3.5cm) in size

Additional requirements babies below 3 years old

  • For newborns and infants, it's acceptable for the baby to be lying down on a white sheet or blanket, as long as the background remains plain and white
  • The baby's face must be clearly visible, without any shadows or glare obscuring their features
  • The baby's eyes should be open, but if this is not possible, the eyes can be closed as long as they are not covered by any objects or shadows

Prices and where to get your photos

The cost of obtaining Nigerian biometric baby passport photos can vary depending on the provider and location. On average, you can expect to pay between ₦500 and ₦2,000 for a set of passport photos that meet the required specifications.

There are several options available for getting your baby's passport photos taken:

  2. Pharmacies and retail stores: Some pharmacies and retail stores in Nigeria have photo booths or provide passport photo services. Prices are usually competitive, ranging from ₦500 to ₦1,500.
  3. Smartphone iD App: Our app offers the most cost-effective and convenient solution, allowing you to take the photos from the comfort of your own home. Simply download the app from the App Store or Google Play Store and follow the instructions in the app.

item.title: How to apply for a Schengen Visa from Nigeria
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
Are you a Nigerian citizen dreaming of exploring Europe? To make your travel dreams a reality, you'll need to obtain a Schengen visa. In this comprehensive guide, we'll walk you through the process of applying for a Schengen visa from Nigeria.

Do Nigerians need a Schengen visa?

Nigerian citizens who wish to travel to any of the 26 Schengen Area countries for tourism, business, or other short-term purposes must obtain a Schengen visa before their trip. The Schengen Area includes most European Union countries.

Where to apply for a Schengen visa in Nigeria

To apply for a Schengen visa, you must submit your application at the embassy or consulate of the Schengen country you intend to visit. If you plan to visit multiple Schengen countries, apply at the embassy or consulate of the country where you will spend the most time or the country you will enter first.

When to apply for a Schengen visa

It is recommended to apply for your Schengen visa at least 15 days before your planned trip, but no earlier than 6 months in advance. Keep in mind that processing times may vary depending on the embassy or consulate, so it's best to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute stress.

How to apply for a Schengen visa from Nigeria

To apply for a Schengen visa from Nigeria, follow these steps:

  1. Determine the type of Schengen visa you need based on the purpose of your trip (tourism, business, study, etc.).
  2. Gather all the required documents (see the next section for details).
  3. Fill out the Schengen visa application form online or in-person at the embassy or consulate.
  4. Schedule an appointment for your visa interview and biometric data collection (fingerprints and photograph).
  5. Attend your visa interview and submit your application, along with the required documents and visa fee.
  6. Wait for the embassy or consulate to process your application and notify you of their decision.

Schengen visa requirements for Nigerians

When applying for a Schengen visa from Nigeria, you must provide the following documents:

  • A valid passport with at least two blank pages and a validity of at least three months beyond your intended stay
  • Completed and signed Schengen visa application form
  • Two recent passport-sized photographs that meet Schengen visa photo requirements
  • Proof of travel arrangements, such as round-trip flight tickets and hotel reservations
  • Travel insurance covering medical expenses and repatriation, with a minimum coverage of €30,000
  • Proof of sufficient financial means to cover your expenses during your stay, such as bank statements or a sponsorship letter
  • Supporting documents based on the purpose of your trip (e.g., invitation letter for business trips, enrollment certificate for study purposes)

Schengen visa fee for Nigerians

The Schengen visa fee for Nigerian citizens is €80 for adults and €40 for children aged 6-12 years. Children under 6 years old are exempt from the visa fee. Keep in mind that the visa fee is non-refundable, even if your application is rejected.

Processing times for Schengen visas

The processing time for Schengen visas can vary depending on the embassy or consulate and the time of year you apply. On average, it takes around 15 days to process a Schengen visa application. However, in some cases, it may take up to 30 days or more. To avoid delays, ensure that you provide all the required documents and information in your application.

Obtain your Schengen visa photo quickly with Smartphone iD

The Smartphone iD app simplifies the process of capturing a Schengen visa photo. Our user-friendly interface provides real-time instructions, ensuring that your photo meets all requirements. After you take a photo, our advanced AI and team of experts verify it within a couple of minutes. Once approved, your digital passport photo is delivered directly to your email, saving you time and money. Smartphone iD offers the most cost-effective and convenient solution for obtaining a high-quality passport photo.

item.title: How to apply for a United States visa from Nigeria
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
Are you a Nigerian citizen planning to travel to the United States? Whether you're visiting for business, tourism, or studying abroad, you'll need to obtain a valid US visa. In this guide, we'll walk you through the process of applying for a US visa from Nigeria, including the requirements, application steps, and processing times.

Do Nigerians need a US visa?

Nigerian citizens are required to obtain a valid visa to enter the United States for any purpose, including tourism, business, study, or work. The type of visa you need depends on the reason for your visit and the length of your stay.

Where to apply for a US visa in Nigeria

To apply for a US visa, you must schedule an appointment at the US Embassy or Consulate in Nigeria. The US Embassy is located in Abuja, while the US Consulate is in Lagos. You can schedule your appointment online through the official US visa application website.

When to apply for a US visa

It's recommended to apply for your US visa well in advance of your planned travel date, as processing times can vary. Generally, you should apply at least three months before your intended departure date to allow sufficient time for processing and any additional administrative procedures.

How to apply for a US visa from Nigeria

To apply for a US visa from Nigeria, follow these steps:

  1. Determine the type of visa you need based on your purpose of travel.
  2. Complete the online nonimmigrant visa application form (DS-160).
  3. Pay the visa application fee.
  4. Schedule an interview appointment at the US Embassy or Consulate.
  5. Gather the required documents for your visa application.
  6. Attend your visa interview and provide biometric information.
  7. Wait for your visa application to be processed.

US visa requirements for Nigerian citizens

When applying for a US visa, you'll need to provide the following documents:

  • A valid Nigerian passport with at least six months validity beyond your intended stay in the US
  • A completed nonimmigrant visa application form (DS-160)
  • A valid email address to receive important notifications
  • A recent passport-style photograph that meets the US visa photo requirements
  • Proof of payment for the visa application fee
  • Supporting documents based on your visa category (e.g., invitation letter, proof of financial support, educational documents)

How to schedule a US visa appointment in Nigeria

To schedule your US visa appointment, follow these steps:

  1. Create an account on the US visa application website.
  2. Complete the online nonimmigrant visa application form (DS-160).
  3. Pay the visa application fee.
  4. Log in to your account and select "Schedule Appointment."
  5. Choose the US Embassy or Consulate where you wish to attend your interview.
  6. Select an available date and time for your appointment.
  7. Confirm your appointment details and print the confirmation page.

US visa fee in Nigeria

The US visa application fee varies depending on the type of visa you're applying for. As of 2024, the most common nonimmigrant visa categories (e.g., B1/B2 for business or tourism) have a fee of $185 USD. You can pay the visa fee online or at designated banks in Nigeria.

US visa processing times in Nigeria

Processing times for US visas can vary depending on the visa category and individual circumstances. After your visa interview, the consular officer will inform you if your application requires additional administrative processing. In general, most nonimmigrant visa applications are processed within a few weeks, but some cases may take longer.

Get your US visa photo with Smartphone iD

The Smartphone iD app allows you to take your US visa passport photo from the comfort of your own home using your smartphone camera. It provides real-time instructions to ensure your photo meets the strict requirements set by the US government. After capturing your photo, our advanced AI algorithms and team of experts verify the image to guarantee compliance. 

Once your photo is approved, the digital file is sent directly to your email, ready for use in your US visa application. As the most affordable passport photo option on the market, Smartphone iD offers a convenient and reliable solution for obtaining your US visa photo.

item.title: How to apply for a Canada visa from Nigeria
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
Are you a Nigerian citizen who wants to visit Canada? In that case, you need a Canada visa. In this comprehensive guide, we'll walk you through the process of applying for a Canada visa from Nigeria, including the requirements, fees, and processing times. By the end, you'll have a clear understanding of how to navigate the Canadian visa application process.

Do Nigerians need a Canada visa?

Yes, Nigerian citizens are required to obtain a valid visa before traveling to Canada for tourism, business, or other short-term purposes. Without a visa, you will not be allowed to enter the country.

Where to apply for a Canada visa in Nigeria

To apply for a Canada visa, you must submit your application online through the official Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) website at https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/application/account.html. You can create an account and complete the necessary forms from the comfort of your home.

When to apply for a Canada visa

It is recommended that you apply for your Canada visa well in advance of your planned travel date. Processing times can vary depending on the volume of applications and individual circumstances. Generally, it's best to apply at least 2-3 months before your intended departure to allow sufficient time for processing.

How to apply for a Canada visa from Nigeria

To apply for a Canada visa from Nigeria, follow these steps:

  1. Determine the type of visa you need based on your purpose of travel (e.g., tourist visa, business visa, student visa).
  2. Create an account on the IRCC website and complete the online application form.
  3. Gather and upload the required documents, including your passport, photographs, proof of financial support, and travel itinerary.
  4. Pay the visa application fee online using a credit card.
  5. Submit your application and wait for a decision from the IRCC.

Canada visa requirements for Nigerian citizens

When applying for a Canada visa from Nigeria, you will need to provide the following documents:

  • A valid Nigerian passport with at least 6 months of remaining validity
  • Completed online visa application form
  • Two recent passport-sized photographs meeting the IRCC's specifications
  • Proof of financial support, such as bank statements or a letter of sponsorship
  • Travel itinerary, including flight and accommodation bookings
  • Other supporting documents depending on your purpose of travel (e.g., letter of invitation for business trips, acceptance letter for students)

Canada visa fee in Nigeria

As of 2024, the Canada visa fee for Nigerian citizens is 100 Canadian dollars (approximately 60,000 Nigerian naira) for most visa types. This fee is non-refundable and must be paid online during the application process.

Canada visa processing times for Nigerian applicants

Processing times for Canada visas can vary depending on the visa type and individual circumstances. On average, Nigerian applicants can expect to receive a decision within 15-30 days of submitting a complete application. However, it's important to note that some cases may take longer, especially if additional information or documentation is required.

Get your Canada visa photo with Smartphone iD

One of the requirements for a successful Canada visa application is providing high-quality passport photographs that meet the IRCC's strict guidelines. This is where Smartphone iD comes in. Our user-friendly app allows you to take your visa photos using your smartphone camera, with real-time instructions to ensure compliance with the IRCC's specifications.

After taking your photo, our advanced AI and team of experts verify the image to guarantee its acceptance. Once approved, your digital visa photo is sent directly to your email, ready for upload to your online application.

item.title: How to apply for a United KingdomVisa from Nigeria
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
If you're a Nigerian citizen planning to visit the United Kingdom, you'll need to obtain a visa before your trip. The visa application process can seem daunting, but with the right information and preparation, it doesn't have to be. In this guide, we'll walk you through the steps of applying for a UK visa from Nigeria, including the requirements, fees, and processing times.

Do Nigerians need a UK visa? 

Nigerian citizens require a valid visa to enter the United Kingdom for any purpose, whether it's for tourism, business, study, or transit. Without a visa, you won't be allowed to board your flight or enter the country upon arrival. It's important to apply for the appropriate visa type based on the reason for your visit and to make sure you meet all the eligibility criteria.

Where to apply for a UK visa in Nigeria 

Applications for UK visas in Nigeria are handled by the UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI) department, which has outsourced the process to authorized Visa Application Centers (VACs). These VACs are operated by TLS Contact, and there are currently two locations in Nigeria - one in Abuja and another in Lagos. 

You'll need to create an account on the TLS Contact website, complete the online application form, and schedule an appointment to submit your biometric information and supporting documents at your chosen VAC.

When to apply for your UK visa 

It's important to start the visa application process well in advance of your intended travel date, as it can take several weeks to receive a decision. You can apply up to three months before your trip, and it's recommended to do so as early as possible to allow ample time for processing. Keep in mind that certain visa types, such as the Standard Visitor Visa, may have specific validity periods, so make sure your visa will be valid for the entirety of your planned stay in the UK.

How to apply for a UK visa from Nigeria 

To apply for a UK visa from Nigeria, follow these steps:

  1. Determine the appropriate visa type for your purpose of visit (e.g., Standard Visitor Visa, Student Visa, etc.).
  2. Create an account on the UK Visas and Immigration website and complete the online application form.
  3. Pay the visa fee online using a credit or debit card.
  4. Book an appointment at your nearest TLS Contact Visa Application Center in Abuja or Lagos.
  5. Attend your appointment and submit your biometric information (fingerprints and photograph) along with your supporting documents.
  6. Wait for a decision on your application, which will be communicated via email or SMS.

UK visa requirements for Nigerian applicants 

When applying for a UK visa from Nigeria, you'll need to provide several documents to support your application:

  • A valid passport with at least one blank page for the visa stamp
  • Completed online application form
  • Two recent passport-sized photographs meeting UK visa specifications
  • Proof of financial means to cover your expenses during your stay
  • Evidence of accommodation arrangements in the UK
  • Detailed travel itinerary
  • Tuberculosis test results (if required)
  • Biometric information (fingerprints and digital photograph)
  • Additional documents depending on your visa type and personal circumstances

UK visa fees in Nigeria 

The cost of a UK visa for Nigerian citizens varies depending on the type of visa and its validity period. For example, a Standard Visitor Visa valid for 6 months costs £115, while a Student Visa costs £490. These fees are non-refundable and must be paid online as part of the application process. It's important to note that visa fees are subject to change, so always check the official UKVI website for the most up-to-date information: https://www.gov.uk/visa-fees.

Processing times for UK visas in Nigeria 

The processing time for UK visas in Nigeria can vary depending on the visa type and the volume of applications received. On average, you can expect to receive a decision within 3-4 weeks of submitting your application and supporting documents. However, some visa types, such as Settlement Visas, may take longer due to the complexity of the application. In certain cases, you may be able to pay an additional fee for priority or super-priority processing to receive a faster decision.

Get your UK visa photo with Smartphone iD 

To ensure your UK visa application goes smoothly, one of the most important steps is providing a high-quality UK visa passport photo that meets the strict requirements set by the UKVI. This is where Smartphone iD comes in - our app is the most affordable and convenient option for taking your passport photo right from your smartphone. Simply download the app, follow the real-time instructions, and our advanced AI and team of experts will verify your photo to guarantee compliance. Once approved, your digital passport photo will be sent directly to your email, ready to submit with your visa application.

item.title: How to apply for an international passport in Nigeria

item.content:encoded:
Applying for an international passport is a key requirement for all Nigerian citizens who wish to travel abroad. In this article, we'll guide you through the steps involved in applying for your Nigerian passport, including the required documents and how to get a passport photo. 

What is an international passport?

An international passport is an official travel document issued by the Nigerian government that allows you to travel abroad. It serves as proof of your identity and nationality, and is required for international travel. Your Nigerian passport is valid for a period of 5 or 10 years, depending on your age and the type of passport you apply for.

How to apply for an international passport in Nigeria

Follow these steps to apply for your Nigerian international passport:

  1. Gather the required documents (see below).
  2. Fill out the online application form on the Nigeria Immigration Service (NIS) website.
  3. Print out the completed application form.
  4. Schedule an appointment at your nearest NIS office.
  5. Attend your appointment, bringing all required documents and passport photos.
  6. Pay the necessary fees.
  7. Provide your biometric data (fingerprints and photograph).
  8. Collect your passport when it's ready (typically within 1-3 weeks).

Required documents for a Nigerian international passport

Before beginning your application, ensure you have the following documents:

  • Completed online application form
  • Birth certificate or age declaration
  • National Identity Number (NIN)
  • Valid form of identification (e.g., driver's license, national ID card)
  • Passport photographs that meet NIS requirements
  • Evidence of payment of the passport fee

item.title: How to apply for a passport in Singapore
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
Applying for a passport in Singapore is a straightforward process, but it's important to understand the requirements and steps involved. In this comprehensive guide, we'll walk you through everything you need to know about obtaining or renewing your Singapore passport. We'll also discuss how to replace a lost or damaged passport and answer some frequently asked questions.

Can you apply for a passport online? 

Yes, you can apply for a Singapore passport online through the ICA website. This is the most convenient and efficient method, as it allows you to complete the application process from the comfort of your home. However, you can also apply by post or by using a deposit box if you prefer.

How to apply for a passport 

To apply for a passport in Singapore, you have several options:

1. Online application:

 Visit the ICA website and complete the online application form. Upload a digital passport photo and make the payment electronically.

2. By post: 

Obtain the application form from the ICA website, complete it, and mail it along with the required documents and payment to the ICA.

3. Deposit box:

 Place your completed application form, required documents, and payment in an ICA deposit box located at selected locations.

In-person:

 Apply at the ICA Building or at a Singapore overseas mission if you are residing abroad.

Documents required for passport application 

When applying for a passport, you will need to submit the following documents:

  • Completed application form
  • Valid passport photo (1 digital photo for online applications)
  • Identity card (NRIC) for Singaporeans or valid Entry/Re-entry Permit for Permanent Residents
  • Proof of citizenship (e.g., birth certificate or citizenship certificate)
  • Additional documents may be required in specific cases, such as for minors or those applying from overseas

Cost of a Singapore passport 

The cost of a Singapore passport varies depending on the type of passport and the method of application. Here are the current fees:

Standard passport (child/adult) - new/renew:

  • Online, by post, or deposit box: S$70
  • In-person at ICA or Singapore overseas missions: S$80

Replacing a lost/damaged passport:

  • First time: S$50 in addition to the standard fee
  • Subsequent times: S$100 in addition to the standard fee

Types of passports in Singapore 

There are two main types of passports issued in Singapore:

  1. Standard passport: This is the most common type of passport, issued to citizens and permanent residents for international travel.
  2. Diplomatic/Official passport: These passports are issued to government officials and diplomats for official travel purposes.

Processing time for passport

Applications 

The processing time for passport applications depends on the method of application and the volume of applications received. Generally, online applications take around 1 to 2 weeks, while applications submitted by post or deposit box may take 2 to 3 weeks. In-person applications at the ICA Building have the shortest processing time of 1 to 2 days, but they will only be accepted in urgent circumstances.

Passport validity 

Singapore passports are valid for a period of either 5 or 10 years. The 5-year validity is standard for children under 16 years old, while adults aged 16 and above are issued passports with a 10-year validity.

Collecting your passport 

Once your passport application has been processed, you will be notified to collect your new passport. You can collect it in person at the ICA Building or have it delivered to your registered address. To ensure a hassle-free collection process, make sure to bring along the required documents, such as your identity card and the passport collection notice.

Guaranteed acceptance with a Smartphone iD passport photo 

To guarantee the acceptance of your passport photo, use our app to take and submit a high-quality digital photo. Our Smartphone iD app is designed to ensure that your photo meets all the necessary requirements, with a team of biometric experts and an advanced AI system checking each photo for compliance. It's the most cost-effective and efficient way to obtain a valid passport photo for your application.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

1. What should I do if I need to travel urgently but I do not have a valid passport?

In urgent situations, you can apply for a passport in person at the ICA Building. However, you will need to provide proof of your urgent travel need, such as a confirmed flight booking or an official letter from your employer. The ICA will assess your case and may issue a passport on an expedited basis if deemed necessary.

2. How do I apply for a baby's passport?

To apply for a baby's passport, you will need to submit the completed application form along with the baby's birth certificate, parents' identity cards, and a valid passport photo of the baby. The application process is similar to that for adults, but both parents must sign the application form unless one parent has sole custody

3. What should I do if my Singapore passport is lost, stolen, or damaged while I'm abroad?

If your passport is lost, stolen, or damaged while you're overseas, contact the nearest Singapore embassy or consulate immediately. They will assist you in obtaining an Emergency Certificate to facilitate your return to Singapore. Upon your return, you can apply for a replacement passport at the ICA Building.

4. Can I renew my expired passport, or do I need to apply for a new one?

In Singapore, you cannot renew an expired passport. Instead, you must apply for a new passport following the standard application process. Make sure to apply for a new passport well before your current one expires to avoid any inconvenience.

5. How do I submit my passport photo for online applications?

When applying for a passport online, you will need to upload a digital passport photo. Use our Smartphone iD app to capture and submit a high-quality photo that meets all the necessary requirements. Our app makes it easy to take a valid passport photo from the comfort of your home, saving you time and money.

item.title: How to apply for your Singapore identity card (IC)
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
Applying for a Singapore identity card (IC) is a process that every citizen and permanent resident must go through. In this article, we'll guide you through the application process, eligibility criteria, required documents, and how to ensure your IC photo meets the necessary standards.

Who can get an IC

Singapore citizens and permanent residents are eligible to apply for an IC. This includes those who have recently become citizens or permanent residents, as well as those who need to re-register their ICs when they turn 30 or 55 years old.

How to apply for your IC

To apply for your IC, follow these steps:

  1. Visit the ICA website and complete the online application form.
  2. If you are a Singapore citizen or permanent resident who does not attend a government or government-aided school, or if you missed your school registration day, you will be prompted to make an appointment for biometrics enrolment in person at the ICA Building.
  3. Attend your biometrics enrolment appointment at the ICA Building, if required.
  4. Pay the application fee.
  5. Wait for your IC to be processed and collect it when ready.

Note: In addition to the online registration, the enrolment of biometrics is required for all applicants.

Required documents for Singapore citizens and permanent residents

When applying for your IC, you will need to provide the following documents:

  • Completed application form
  • Recent passport-sized color photograph that meets the ICA's requirements
  • Proof of citizenship or permanent residency
  • Any other supporting documents as required by the ICA

Cost and processing time

The cost of applying for an IC varies depending on your citizenship status. Singapore citizens will need to pay a fee of S$10, while Singapore permanent residents will be charged S$50. The processing time for IC applications is typically around seven working days, but it may take longer during peak periods. Your application will be delayed if your photograph and/or supporting document (if applicable) do not meet the requirements. 

Validity of your IC

Your IC is valid for 10 years from the date of issue. It is important to keep your IC up to date and renew it before it expires to avoid any inconvenience or penalties.

Collecting your IC

Once your IC application has been processed, you will receive a notification from the ICA informing you that your IC is ready for collection. You can collect your IC in person at the ICA Building or at a designated collection center. Remember to bring along your collection slip and any required documents.

Guaranteeing your identity card photo with Smartphone iD

To ensure that your IC photo meets the necessary standards, consider using the Smartphone iD app. Our app allows you to easily take a compliant passport photo directly from your smartphone, without the need for a professional photographer or studio. The app guides you through the process, ensuring that your photo meets the required dimensions, background, and lighting conditions. Once you've taken the photo, our advanced AI technology and team of experts checks it against the ICA's requirements, making sure it will be accepted on the first attempt. 

Frequently asked questions (FAQ)

1. When do I need to re-register my IC if I'm 30 or 55 years old? 

Eligible Singapore citizens and permanent residents will receive a notification letter from the ICA by post when it is time to re-register their ICs. Upon receiving the notification letter, you are required to re-register your IC within one year from the date of the letter at a subsidized fee.

2. Can I apply for a Singapore IC when living abroad? 

Yes, you can apply for a Singapore IC even if you are living overseas. You will need to complete the online application process and may be required to visit the nearest Singapore embassy or consulate for biometrics enrolment.

3. What should I do if my Singapore IC is lost, stolen, or damaged? 

If your Singapore IC is lost, stolen, or damaged, you should report it to the ICA immediately. You will need to visit the ICA Building in person to apply for a replacement IC and pay the applicable fee.

4. Can I renew my IC online? 

No, you cannot renew your IC online. You will need to visit the ICA Building in person to re-register your IC when you turn 30 or 55 years old, or when your existing IC expires.

5. How many photos do I need to submit for my IC application? 

You only need to submit one recent passport-sized color photograph that meets the ICA's requirements. With the Smartphone iD app, you can easily take and submit a compliant photo directly from your smartphone.

Sources

https://www.ica.gov.sg/documents/ic/re-registration

item.title: How to apply for a residency permit in Singapore
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
Are you looking to make Singapore your permanent home? Applying for a residency permit is an important step towards achieving that goal. In this article, we'll guide you through the process of applying for a residency permit in Singapore, including eligibility requirements, application steps, required documents, and processing time. 

Residency permit eligibility

To be eligible for permanent residence in Singapore, you must meet one of the following criteria:

  • Be a foreign investor in Singapore
  • Be a student studying in Singapore who has passed at least one national exam (such as PSLE, GCE 'N'/'O'/'A' levels), or be enrolled in the Integrated Programme (IP)
  • Be an aged parent of a Singapore citizen
  • Be an unmarried child under 21 years old, born within the context of a legal marriage to, or legally adopted by, a Singapore citizen or permanent resident (PR)
  • Be the spouse of a Singapore citizen or Singapore permanent resident (PR)

If you fall into one of these categories, you may be able to apply for permanent residency in Singapore. The application process will vary depending on your specific circumstances.

How to apply for a residency permit

To apply for a residency permit in Singapore, follow these steps:

  1. Check your eligibility using the e-Service provided by the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA).
  2. Submit your application online via the e-PR system.
  3. Pay the application fee of S$100.
  4. Attend an interview at ICA if required.
  5. Wait for the outcome of your application, which typically takes 4-6 months.

Required documents for a residency permit application

When applying for a residency permit, you will need to provide several supporting documents:

  • A valid passport with at least 6 months validity
  • A passport-sized digital color photograph taken within the last 3 months that meets ICA's photo requirements
  • Educational certificates
  • Payslips or income tax statements for the last 6 months
  • Marriage certificate and birth certificate of children (if applicable)
  • Birth certificate or household register (only for births not registered in Singapore)

Residency permit application cost and processing time

The application fee for a residency permit is S$100 per applicant. Processing time typically takes 4-6 months from the time all required documents are received. During this period, ICA may request additional documents or invite you for an interview.

Residency permit validity

If your application is approved, your residency permit will be valid for 5 years. You can renew it before expiration for another 5 years as long as you still meet the eligibility criteria. After being a permanent resident for at least 2 years, you may be eligible to apply for Singapore citizenship.

How to collect your residency permit

Once your residency permit is approved, you will receive a notification letter from ICA with instructions on how to complete the formalities:

  1. Make an e-Appointment online to collect your permit.
  2. Visit the ICA building and proceed to the permanent residence services section.
  3. Complete registration formalities and get your permit endorsed in your passport.
  4. Obtain your identity card on the spot.

Get your residency permit photo with Smartphone iD

Taking a compliant passport photo is a simple process with the Smartphone iD app. Simply follow the real-time instructions provided by the app to capture your photo. Once you've taken the perfect shot, our advanced AI system and team of experts analyze the photo to verify compliance with government regulations. After the quick verification process, your passport photo is sent directly to your email, ready for use in your residency permit application. 

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

1. How long does it take to get a residency permit in Singapore?

The processing time for a residency permit application typically takes 4-6 months from the time all required documents are received by ICA.

2. What is the minimum salary to get a residency permit?

There is no fixed minimum salary requirement for a residency permit. However, your income will be considered as part of your application assessment. Generally, a higher salary may improve your chances of approval.

3. Can I include my dependent family members in my application?

Yes, you can include your spouse and unmarried children under 21 in your residency permit application. They will need to meet the eligibility criteria and submit required documents as well.

4. How often do I need to renew my residency permit?

Your residency permit is valid for 5 years. You can renew it before expiration for another 5 years as long as you still meet the eligibility criteria.

5. Can I appeal if my residency permit application is rejected?

If your application is rejected, you may submit an appeal within 6 months of the rejection date. However, the success rate for appeals is generally low, so it's important to ensure your initial application is as strong as possible.

item.title: How to apply for a Singapore visa
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
Are you planning a trip to Singapore? In that case, you might need a visa. In this comprehensive guide, we'll walk you through everything you need to know about applying for a Singapore visa, including eligibility, application methods, required documents, and fees. We'll also provide some helpful tips to ensure a smooth application process.

Singapore visa eligibility

To determine if you need a visa to enter Singapore, check the official list of visa-required countries on the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA) website: https://www.ica.gov.sg/enter-transit-depart/entering-singapore/visa_requirements. Citizens of certain countries may be eligible for visa-free entry or can apply for an e-Visa.

Can I apply online?

Applying for a Singapore visa online is possible if you have a local contact in Singapore who is a citizen or Permanent Resident with a valid SingPass account. Your local contact can submit your application on your behalf through the ICA website (https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/esvclandingpage/save) by logging in to their SingPass account, completing the online form, and uploading the required documents. They will be responsible for the accuracy of the information provided and will need to pay the visa fee online.

If you don't have a local contact who can assist you with the online application, you'll need to consider alternative methods, such as applying through an authorized visa agent or at the nearest Singapore Overseas Mission.

How to apply

There are two main ways to apply for a Singapore visa:

  1. Through an authorized visa agent: You can engage the services of a trusted visa agent who will guide you through the application process and submit the necessary documents on your behalf.
  2. At the nearest Singapore Overseas Mission: Locate the nearest Singapore Embassy or Consulate in your country and submit your visa application in person or by mail.

Required documents

When applying for a Singapore visa, you'll typically need to provide the following documents:

  • A completed visa application form
  • A valid passport with at least 6 months validity from the date of entry into Singapore
  • Recent passport-sized photographs that meet the ICA's requirements
  • Proof of sufficient funds for your stay in Singapore
  • Confirmed flight itinerary or proof of onward/return travel arrangements
  • Accommodation details for your stay in Singapore
  • Supporting documents based on the purpose of your visit (e.g., business letter, invitation letter, or proof of relationship for family visits)

Singapore visa fee

The processing fee for a Singapore visa application is US$22.00 per application. This fee is non-refundable, regardless of the outcome of your application or if you choose to withdraw your application after submission.

Processing time and collection

The processing time for Singapore visa applications generally takes between 3 to 8 business days from the date the complete application is received. However, some applications may require more time to process. To account for any potential delays in processing or postal delivery, it's highly recommended that you submit your application well in advance of your planned travel date. 

There is no expedited service available. It's crucial to ensure that your application is complete and accurate before submission. Incomplete applications may be rejected outright or experience significant delays in processing.

Additional tips

To increase your chances of a successful visa application, make sure to:

  • Provide accurate and complete information in your application
  • Submit all required documents, including a high-quality passport photo that meets the ICA's specifications
  • Apply well in advance of your intended travel date
  • Consider using the Smartphone iD app to guarantee a valid passport photo that meets the requirements set by the ICA

Get your passport photo with the Smartphone iD app

Ensuring that your passport photo meets the ICA's requirements is crucial for a successful Singapore visa application. The Smartphone iD app makes this process easy and convenient. Our app provides real-time instructions to help you capture the perfect passport photo, which is then verified by our team of experts and advanced AI system. Once your photo is verified, it's sent directly to your email, ready for you to submit with your visa application. 

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

1. Can I apply for a Singapore visa on arrival?

No, Singapore does not offer visa-on-arrival facilities. You must apply for a visa in advance through the prescribed methods.

2. How long is a Singapore visa valid for?

The validity of a Singapore visa depends on the type of visa and the purpose of your visit. Most short-term visas are valid for stays of up to 30 days.

3. Can I extend my Singapore visa?

In most cases, Singapore visas cannot be extended. If you need to stay longer than the validity of your visa, you'll need to apply for a new visa or seek approval from the ICA.

Sources

item.title: How to get a passport photo for your baby in Singapore
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
If you plan to travel with your baby, he or she will need a passport. To apply for your baby's passport, you need to provide a suitable passport photo that meets the specific requirements set by the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) in Singapore. This article tells you how to get a passport photo for your baby in Singapore, and provides information on the requirements and prices.

Requirements and size for baby passport photos

When it comes to baby passport photos, the following requirements must be met to ensure your application is accepted:

  • The photo should be in color, taken against a white background, and have a clear, front view of your baby's face.
  • Your baby's eyes should be open and looking directly at the camera, with a neutral expression.
  • The photo should be recent, taken within the last 6 months.
  • The size of the baby passport photo should be 35mm x 45mm, with the head size measuring between 25mm to 35mm from the chin to the crown.
  • The photo should not be digitally altered or have any shadows or glare.

Requirements for babies under 3 years old

For babies under 3 years old, there are additional requirements to keep in mind:

  • Your baby's head should be supported if they cannot sit up on their own, but the support should not be visible in the photo.
  • It's acceptable for your baby's eyes to be closed or looking away from the camera, as long as the photo still meets all the other requirements.

Prices for baby passport photos in Singapore

The cost of baby passport photos can vary depending on where you go. Traditional photo studios typically charge between $15 to $30 for a set of passport photos, while automated photo booths may cost around $10 to $20.  Smartphone iD offers the lowest prices on the market, without compromising on the quality of your photos.

item.title: How to get a passport photo for your Singapore visa
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
Are you planning to apply for a Singapore visa? One of the most important requirements is a high-quality passport photo that meets the strict guidelines set by the Singapore government. In this article, we'll guide you through the process of obtaining the perfect passport photo for your Singapore visa application, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free experience.

What is the required size for a Singapore visa passport photo?

To ensure a successful Singapore visa application, your passport photo must adhere to the following requirements:

  • Size: The photo should measure 35mm in width and 45mm in height. Any deviations from these dimensions may result in the rejection of your visa application.
  • Background: Your photo must be taken against a plain white background, ensuring that your face is the main focus of the image. Avoid any patterns, shadows, or distractions in the background.
  • Face: Your face should be clearly visible and centered within the frame of the photo. Make sure that your face occupies about 70-80% of the image, and that your features are easily distinguishable.
  • Expression: Maintain a neutral facial expression, with your eyes open and looking directly at the camera. Avoid smiling, frowning, or making any exaggerated expressions that may distort your natural appearance.

By strictly adhering to these guidelines, you can minimize the risk of delays or rejection in your Singapore visa application process.

How to submit your visa passport photo to the application

When it comes to submitting your passport photo for your Singapore visa application, you have two main options:

  • Physical print: You can provide a high-quality physical print of your passport photo that meets all the requirements. Ensure that the print is not damaged, creased, or faded, as this may compromise the quality of your application.
  • Digital copy: Alternatively, you can submit a digital copy of your passport photo. If you choose this option, make sure that the photo is in JPEG format and has a resolution of at least 300 dpi (dots per inch). The file size should not exceed 2MB to ensure smooth uploading and processing.

item.title: How to get a Singapore Long Term Visit Pass
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
Are you looking to stay in Singapore for an extended period of time? In that case, you might need a Long Term Visit Pass (LTVP). In this comprehensive guide, we'll walk you through the types of LTVPs, the eligibility requirements and the application process.

What is a Long Term Visit Pass (LTVP)?

An LTVP is a pass issued by the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) of Singapore that allows foreign nationals to stay in Singapore for an extended period. The pass is typically valid for up to two years and can be renewed upon expiration. 

It is designed for individuals who wish to stay in Singapore for purposes such as joining their family members, receiving education, or undergoing medical treatment. The LTVP is a non-immigrant pass and does not grant the holder the right to work or conduct business in Singapore without obtaining the necessary work permits or approvals.

Types of Long Term Visit Pass

There are two main types of LTVPs:

  1. Dependent's Pass (LTVP): This pass is for those sponsored by a Singapore Citizen (SC) or Permanent Resident (PR) family member. It is suitable for spouses, unmarried children under 21 years old, and parents of SCs or PRs. The sponsor must demonstrate their ability to support the LTVP holder financially during their stay in Singapore.
  2. Long-Term Visit Pass - Letter of Consent (LOC): This pass is for those sponsored by a company in Singapore. It is typically used for employees' dependents, such as spouses and children, who wish to accompany the employee during their employment in Singapore. The sponsoring company must take responsibility for the LTVP holder's stay and repatriation if necessary.

Long Term Visit Pass eligibility

To be eligible for an LTVP, you must be:

  • A spouse or unmarried child (under 21 years old) of an SC or PR
  • A parent of an SC
  • A relative or friend of an SC or PR
  • A common-law spouse or stepchild of an SC or PR
  • Sponsored by a company in Singapore

Additionally, you must meet the following criteria:

  • Have a valid passport with at least 6 months' validity
  • Have sufficient funds to support your stay in Singapore
  • Have a sponsor who is an SC, PR, or a company in Singapore
  • Meet the prevailing entry requirements and guidelines set by ICA

Can you apply for a Long Term Visit Pass online?

Yes, the application for an LTVP is done online via the ICA e-Service portal at https://www.ica.gov.sg/reside/LTVP.

How to apply for a Long Term Visit Pass 

To apply for an LTVP, follow these steps:

  1. Ensure you meet the eligibility criteria
  2. Prepare the required documents
  3. Submit the online application via the ICA e-Service portal
  4. Pay the application fee
  5. Wait for the application to be processed
  6. If approved, collect your LTVP

Required documents for Long Term Visit Pass application

When applying for an LTVP, you'll need to provide the following documents:

  • A completed application form
  • A digital passport photo
  • A copy of your passport bio-data page
  • Proof of relationship with the sponsor (e.g., marriage certificate, birth certificate)
  • Sponsor's documents (e.g., SC/PR identity card, work pass)

Long Term Visit Pass application fees and processing time

The application fee for an LTVP is S$45. This fee is non-refundable, regardless of the outcome of your application. Payment can be made online using various methods, such as credit card or bank transfer, during the application process.

The processing time for LTVP applications typically takes around 4-6 weeks from the date of submission. However, this duration may vary depending on the volume of applications received by ICA and the completeness of your application. It is advisable to apply for your LTVP well in advance of your intended travel date to allow sufficient time for processing. You can check the status of your application online using your application number.

Can Long Term Visit Pass holders work in Singapore?

LTVP holders are not permitted to work in Singapore without a separate work pass. The LTVP is a non-work pass that allows the holder to stay in Singapore for a specific purpose, such as joining family or receiving education. It does not automatically grant the right to seek employment or conduct business in the country.

Get your Singapore Long Term Visit Pass photos with Smartphone iD

Smartphone iD is an innovative app that simplifies the process of taking passport photos for your LTVP application using your smartphone. It offers the best value for money, providing a convenient and cost-effective solution without compromising on quality. 

The app guides you through the photo-taking process with real-time instructions and uses advanced AI to verify that your photo meets ICA's strict requirements. After our quick verification, your digital passport photo is sent directly to your email, ready for your application.

item.title: How to get a Dependant's Pass in Singapore
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
If you are a foreign professional working in Singapore and you wish to bring your family members to live with you, they will need to obtain a Dependant's Pass. This pass allows spouses and children of Employment Pass, Entrepreneur Pass, Personalized Employment Pass, or S Pass holders to join them in Singapore. In this guide, we will walk you through all the important information for obtaining a Dependant's Pass in Singapore.

What is a Dependant's Pass? 

A Dependant's Pass is a type of visa issued by the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) in Singapore that allows family members of foreign professionals working in the country to live with them. This pass is valid for the same duration as the main pass holder's employment pass, up to a maximum of two years. Dependant's Pass holders are allowed to study in Singapore but need to obtain a Letter of Consent (LOC) from MOM if they wish to work.

Eligibility for a Dependant's Pass 

To be eligible for a Dependant's Pass, you must be either the legally married spouse or unmarried child under 21 years old of an Employment Pass, Entrepreneur Pass, Personalized Employment Pass, or S Pass holder. 

The main pass holder must earn a minimum monthly salary of S$6,000 for Employment Pass and S Pass holders, and S$12,000 for Entrepreneur Pass and Personalized Employment Pass holders.

How to apply for a Dependant's Pass 

To apply for a Dependant's Pass, follow these steps:

  1. The main pass holder should log in to their EP Online account and select "Apply for Dependant's Pass".
  2. Fill out the online application form with the required information and upload supporting documents.
  3. Pay the application fee of S$105 for each Dependant's Pass.
  4. Wait for MOM to process the application, which typically takes 3-4 weeks.
  5. Once approved, the main pass holder will receive an In-Principle Approval (IPA) letter via email.
  6. The dependant can then enter Singapore and complete the pass issuance process.

Required documents for a Dependant's Pass application 

When applying for a Dependant's Pass, you will need to provide the following documents:

  • A digital passport-sized photo of the dependant
  • Dependant's passport biodata page
  • Proof of relationship, such as a marriage certificate for spouses or birth certificate for children
  • Main pass holder's Employment Pass, Entrepreneur Pass, Personalized Employment Pass, or S Pass
  • Main pass holder's latest 3 months' payslips or a letter from their employer stating their monthly salary

Fees and processing time for a Dependant's Pass The application fee for a Dependant's Pass is S$105 per pass. If the application is approved, an issuance fee of S$225 per pass must be paid before the pass can be issued. The processing time for a Dependant's Pass application is usually 3-4 weeks, but it may take longer in some cases.

Collecting the Dependant's Pass card 

After arriving in Singapore, the dependant must complete the pass issuance process within 2 weeks. This involves:

  1. Booking an appointment online for pass issuance
  2. Visiting the Employment Pass Services Centre on the appointed date and time
  3. Collecting the Dependant's Pass card and undergoing a fingerprint and photo registration

Get your Dependant's Pass quickly with Smartphone iD

Smartphone iD is a user-friendly app that simplifies the process of getting digital passport photos for various official documents, including the Dependant's Pass in Singapore. Our app provides real-time instructions and verification by a team of experts and advanced AI to ensure that your photo meets the required specifications. Once verified, the digital photo is sent directly to your email, making it easy to include in your application. With Smartphone iD, you can obtain your passport photo quickly and affordably, helping you secure your Dependant's Pass with minimal effort.

item.title: How to get a Certificate of Clearance in Singapore
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
A Certificate of Clearance (COC) is required for purposes such as employment, visa applications, adoption processes, or travel. In this comprehensive guide, we'll walk you through the process of obtaining your COC in Singapore, including eligibility requirements, application steps, and the processing time. We'll also show you the most affordable way to obtain a passport photo that meets the requirements of the COC application.

What is a Certificate of Clearance?

A Certificate of Clearance, also known as a COC, is an official document issued by the Singapore Police Force. It serves as proof that the holder has no criminal record in Singapore. 

Certificate of Clearance Singapore eligibility

To be eligible for a COC in Singapore, you must meet the following criteria:

  • You are a Singaporean citizen, permanent resident, or foreigner who has lived in Singapore for at least six months.
  • You are at least 16 years old.
  • You have a valid reason for applying, such as employment, migration, or adoption.

How to apply for a Certificate of Clearance in Singapore

To apply for your COC, follow these steps:

  1. Visit the Singapore Police Force e-services website at https://eservices1.police.gov.sg/phub/eservices/landingpage/apply-pay-for-coc.
  2. Select "Police Hub".
  3. Choose "Certificate of Clearance".
  4. Fill out the online application form with your personal details and reason for application.
  5. Upload the required documents.
  6. Make the payment online.
  7. Wait for your application to be processed.
  8. Collect your COC from the designated collection point.

Required documents for Certificate of Clearance application

When applying for your COC, you'll need to provide the following documents:

  • A clear, color passport-style photograph taken within the last 3 months
  • A copy of your NRIC (for Singaporeans and PRs) or a copy of your valid passport (for foreigners)
  • A copy of your valid pass (for foreigners)

Certificate of Clearance fees

The fee for a COC application is S$55. This fee is non-refundable, even if your application is rejected. Payment can be made online using a credit card or eNETS.

Processing time for Certificate of Clearance

The processing time for a COC application is approximately 5 working days from the date of application. However, this may vary depending on the volume of applications received and the complexity of your case. It's important to apply well in advance of when you need your COC to allow for any potential delays.

Collection of the Certificate of Clearance in Singapore

Once your COC application has been approved, you'll receive a notification email with instructions on how to collect your document. You can collect your COC from the designated collection point, which is usually the Police Cantonment Complex. Make sure to bring along your original NRIC or passport for verification purposes.

item.title: How to obtain your Nigerian passport
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
Getting a passport is essential if you want to travel abroad. In this comprehensive guide, we'll walk you through the process of applying for a Nigerian passport, both within Nigeria and abroad. We also provide valuable information on required documents, processing time, and frequently asked questions.

How to apply for a Nigerian passport

To apply for a Nigerian passport within Nigeria, follow these steps:

  1. Visit the Nigeria Immigration Service (NIS) portal at https://portal.immigration.gov.ng/.
  2. Click on the "Passport" tab and select "New Application."
  3. Fill out the online application form with your personal details, contact information, and passport type.
  4. Upload a digital passport photo that meets the NIS requirements (600x800 pixels).
  5. Make the necessary payment online using a debit card or bank transfer.
  6. Print out the completed application form and acknowledgment slip.
  7. Schedule an appointment for biometric capture at your chosen NIS passport office.

For Nigerians living outside the country, the process is similar, but you'll need to apply through the nearest Nigerian embassy or consulate.

Required documents

When applying for a Nigerian passport, you'll need to provide the following documents:

  • Completed online application form
  • Acknowledgment slip
  • Birth certificate or age declaration
  • Proof of Nigerian citizenship (e.g., National ID card, voter's card, or certificate of origin)
  • Marriage certificate (for married women who want to use their married name)
  • Letter of authorization and parent's passport data page (for minors)

Cost and processing time

The cost of a Nigerian international passport varies depending on the type and duration of validity:

  • 32-page standard passport (5 years): ₦25,000
  • 64-page standard passport (5 years): ₦35,000
  • 64-page standard passport (10 years): ₦70,000

The processing time for a Nigerian passport is typically 3-6 weeks, but it can take longer during peak periods or if there are issues with your application.

Passport validity

Nigerian passports are valid for either 5 or 10 years, depending on the type you choose. It's important to renew your passport at least 6 months before it expires to avoid any travel disruptions.

Collecting your passport

Once your passport is ready, you'll need to collect it in person at the NIS passport office or Nigerian embassy/consulate where you applied. You'll need to present the following documents:

  1. Acknowledgment slip
  2. Original and photocopies of all supporting documents submitted during the application
  3. Proof of payment

Get your passport photo with Smartphone iD

During your passport application process you need to submit a high-quality, compliant passport photo. Smartphone iD offers an affordable and convenient solution for obtaining such a photo, using just your smartphone. Our app provides real-time instructions and verification by our team of experts and advanced AI, guaranteeing that your digital photo meets all the NIS requirements. Once verified, the photo is sent directly to your email, ready for your online application.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

1. What should I do if I need to travel urgently but I do not have a valid passport? 

In case of an emergency, you can apply for an Emergency Travel Certificate (ETC) at the NIS passport office or Nigerian embassy/consulate. The ETC is a temporary travel document valid for a single journey.

2. How many types of passports are there in Nigeria? 

There are three types of Nigerian passports: standard (32 or 64 pages), official, and diplomatic. Most citizens apply for the standard passport.

3. How to apply for a baby passport? 

To apply for a passport for a baby or minor, parents must first obtain a birth certificate and then follow the regular application process. A letter of authorization and the parent's passport data page will also be required.

4. How to apply for a Nigerian passport when living abroad? 

Nigerians living abroad can apply for a passport at the nearest Nigerian embassy or consulate. The process is similar to applying within Nigeria, but you may need to schedule an appointment for biometric capture at the embassy/consulate.

5. What should I do if my Nigerian passport is lost, stolen, or damaged? 

If your Nigerian passport is lost, stolen, or damaged, you should report it immediately to the nearest police station and NIS passport office or Nigerian embassy/consulate. You'll need to apply for a replacement passport, providing a police report and other required documents.

6. Can I renew my Nigerian passport? 

Yes, you can renew your Nigerian passport by applying for a new one before your current passport expires. The process is similar to applying for a new passport.

7. How many photos are required for a Nigerian passport application? 

For an online application, you'll need to upload one digital passport photo that meets the NIS requirements (600x800 pixels).

8. What is the most affordable way to obtain a valid passport photo? 

The Smartphone iD app offers an inexpensive and convenient solution for taking a compliant passport photo using your smartphone.

item.title: How to obtain your Nigerian national identity card
item.dc:creator: Karen
item.content:encoded:
As a Nigerian citizen or legal resident you need a national identity card for opening bank accounts, voting, and applying for government programs. In this article, we outline who can get a national identity card in Nigeria, the steps involved in the application process, and more. 

Who can get a national identity card?

Every Nigerian citizen, regardless of age, is eligible to obtain a national identity card. This includes children, adults, and senior citizens. Non-Nigerian citizens who are legal residents of Nigeria can also apply for a national identity card. It is important to note that the national identity card is different from the National Identification Number (NIN), which is a unique number assigned to every Nigerian citizen and legal resident.

How to get a national identity card

To get your national identity card, you need to follow these steps:

  1. Visit a National Identity Management Commission (NIMC) enrollment center.
  2. Fill out the application form and provide the required documents.
  3. Have your biometric data captured, including your fingerprints, facial photograph, and signature.
  4. Pay the applicable fee for the national identity card.
  5. Collect your slip containing your NIN and wait for your national identity card to be ready.

Required documents for national identity card registration

When applying for your national identity card, you will need to provide the following documents:

  • Birth certificate or declaration of age
  • Any form of valid identification such as a driver's license, international passport, or voter's card
  • Proof of address such as a utility bill or tenancy agreement
  • Two recent passport photographs

Cost of obtaining a national identity card

The cost of obtaining a national identity card varies depending on the type of card you want. The standard national identity card costs ₦3,000, while the premium card costs ₦5,000. It is important to note that these fees are subject to change, so it is advisable to confirm the current rates at the time of application.

Processing time and validity of the national identity card

The processing time for the national identity card varies depending on the volume of applications received by NIMC. Typically, it takes between one to three months to receive your card after completing the registration process. Once issued, the national identity card is valid for ten years from the date of issuance.

How to collect your national identity card

Once your national identity card is ready, you can collect it at the NIMC office where you registered. You will need to present your NIN slip and a valid means of identification to collect your card. If you are unable to collect your card in person, you can authorize someone else to collect it on your behalf by providing them with a written authorization and a copy of your valid ID.

How to check if your national identity card is ready

To check the status of your national identity card, you can visit the NIMC website and click on the "Check NIN/ID Card Status" link. You will need to enter your NIN and date of birth to access the status of your card. Alternatively, you can visit any NIMC office nationwide to inquire about the status of your card.

Get your identity card passport photo with Smartphone iD

To complete your national identity card application, you will need to provide two recent passport photographs. Smartphone iD can help you obtain these photos for the best price on the market. With our app, you can take your passport photograph using just your smartphone camera. The app provides real-time instructions and verification by our team of experts and advanced AI technology. Once your photograph is verified, the digital copy is sent directly to your email, ready for use in your national identity card application.
